title: Reminders and thanks
noInvitation: This event has no invitation, so there is nothing to send.

expected.lead: “Expected” is worked out from the guest list and the delivery report. The server decides who really gets it, and the outcome says what it did.
expected.refused: Your role can’t read the guest list or the delivery report, so this page can’t say who these would reach.

chase.title: Chase who hasn’t answered
chase.lead: Reminds the households that have the invitation and haven’t answered. Someone who said “not sure yet” has answered, and isn’t chased. A household gets at most one reminder a day. Aveline also sends reminders by itself 21, 7 and 2 days before the event, unless they’ve been switched off for it.

expected.due_one: Expected to get a reminder: {{count, number}} household.
expected.due_other: Expected to get a reminder: {{count, number}} households.
expected.tooRecent_one: Invited too recently: {{count, number}} household. A household waits 3 days after its invitation, or 1 day when the event is under a week away.
expected.tooRecent_other: Invited too recently: {{count, number}} households. A household waits 3 days after its invitation, or 1 day when the event is under a week away.
expected.remindedToday_one: Reminded in the last day: {{count, number}} household.
expected.remindedToday_other: Reminded in the last day: {{count, number}} households.
expected.notReached_one: The invitation hasn’t reached {{count, number}} household: send it to them instead.
expected.notReached_other: The invitation hasn’t reached {{count, number}} households: send it to them instead.
expected.cannotReach_one: Can’t be reached: {{count, number}} household. Correct an address first.
expected.cannotReach_other: Can’t be reached: {{count, number}} households. Correct an address first.
expected.answered_one: Nobody left to chase: {{count, number}} household.
expected.answered_other: Nobody left to chase: {{count, number}} households.

offer.draft: Reminders can be sent once the invitation is published.
offer.closed: Replies are stopped, so reminders aren’t sent. Take replies again on the invitation’s page first.
offer.expired: This invitation’s time has run out, so reminders aren’t sent.
offer.started: The event has started, so reminders aren’t sent any more.

confirm.body: Messages can’t be recalled. The server decides who is due, so the number can differ. Pressing again today sends nobody a second one.

outcome.queued_one: On its way to {{count, number}} household.
outcome.queued_other: On its way to {{count, number}} households.
outcome.alreadyReminded_one: Reminded or tried in the last day, so not sent: {{count, number}} household.
outcome.alreadyReminded_other: Reminded or tried in the last day, so not sent: {{count, number}} households.
outcome.recentlyInvited_one: Invited too recently, so not sent yet: {{count, number}} household.
outcome.recentlyInvited_other: Invited too recently, so not sent yet: {{count, number}} households.
outcome.sendFirst_one: The invitation hasn’t reached {{count, number}} household
outcome.sendFirst_other: The invitation hasn’t reached {{count, number}} households
outcome.sendFirstHelp: A reminder would be the wrong message. Send them the invitation instead.

thank.title: Thank the guests
thank.lead: Goes after the event, once ever per household. This page can’t tell beforehand who has already been thanked; a household that has been isn’t thanked again.

expected.ARRIVED_one: Someone checked in, so it goes to the households where someone arrived. Expected: {{count, number}} household.
expected.ARRIVED_other: Someone checked in, so it goes to the households where someone arrived. Expected: {{count, number}} households.
expected.ACCEPTED_one: Nobody checked in, so it goes to the households where someone said they would come. Expected: {{count, number}} household.
expected.ACCEPTED_other: Nobody checked in, so it goes to the households where someone said they would come. Expected: {{count, number}} households.
expected.cannotReach_one: Can’t be reached: {{count, number}} household. Correct an address first.
expected.cannotReach_other: Can’t be reached: {{count, number}} households. Correct an address first.

offer.draft: A thank-you can be sent once the invitation is published and the event has started.
offer.expired: This invitation’s time has run out, so the link in a thank-you would open nothing. It isn’t offered.
offer.notYet: A thank-you can be sent once the event has started.

basis.ARRIVED: It goes to the households where someone checked in.
basis.ACCEPTED: Nobody checked in, so it goes to everyone who said they would come, whether or not they came.

confirm.body: Each household is thanked once, ever. Messages can’t be recalled. The server decides who gets it, so the number can differ.

basis.ARRIVED: It went by who checked in.
basis.ACCEPTED: Nobody had checked in, so it went by who said they would come.

outcome.queued_one: On its way to {{count, number}} household.
outcome.queued_other: On its way to {{count, number}} households.
outcome.alreadyThanked_one: Already thanked or tried, so not sent again: {{count, number}} household.
outcome.alreadyThanked_other: Already thanked or tried, so not sent again: {{count, number}} households.

outcome.title: What happened
outcome.cannotReachHelp: There is no usable address for them. Add or correct one on the guest list.
outcome.fixOnList: Show them on the guest list
outcome.suppressed: Someone who asked not to be contacted, or whose address bounced, isn’t written to. They aren’t named here, and after another press they count as already tried.

refused.notPublished: This invitation isn’t open for replies, so nothing was sent. The page has been reloaded.
refused.expired: This invitation’s time has run out, so nothing was sent. The page has been reloaded.
refused.started: The event has already started, so no reminder was sent. The page has been reloaded.
refused.notYet: The event hasn’t happened yet, so no thank-you was sent. The page has been reloaded.
refused.gone: This invitation is no longer available. The page has been reloaded.
refused.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t send these. An owner or a coordinator can, and the event’s owner can change your role.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and press again: nobody gets it twice.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. It may have gone out: pressing again is safe, and nobody gets it twice.
refused.other: This wasn’t accepted. The reason, in English:
